title: Umbel pack manifest, version 1
description: pack.toml read as JSON (D46). A pack is a directory with this file and up to three subdirectories: data/, reference/ and rules/. A space may hold a pack of the same id and plugin under spaces/<space>/packs/<plugin id>/<pack id>/, which replaces the plugin's default whole. The limits (1000 files, 64 MiB, no symlink out of the pack) are checked on the directory.
